newsitem.title: FRANCE: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde Oct 24.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde Oct 24.

text.p: These are leading stories in afternoon daily Le Monde.
-- Socialist party leader Lionel Jospin calls for parliamentary investigation of Thomson privatisation.
-- British researchers find first direct experimental link between BSE "mad cow" disease and human equivalent.
-- Air Liberte majority shareholder Rivaud shifts to supporting British Airways' offer to take over insolvent Air Liberte airline and continue its operations.
-- Aircraft engine manufacturer Snecma bids for full control of its 51 percent subsidiary SEP, valued around 1.6 billion francs.
-- Bundesbank economist says rate cut trend nears its end in Germany.
